and WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and WHEREAS, the result of the election for 87-Faridkot Assembly Constituency of Punjab, 2022 was declared by the Returning Officer on 10th March, 2022 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election Expenses was 9th April, 2023; Gurcharan Singh Sangha a contesting candidate from 87-Faridkot Assembly Constituency in General Election to Legislative Assembly of Punjab, 2022 has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as required under law; and WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Faridkot a Show-Cause notice No. 76/PB-LA/87/2022/CEMS-I, dated 15th June, 2022 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India Sh. Gurcharan Singh Sangha for not lodging of account of Election Expenses; and WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Gurcharan Singh Sangha was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District Election Officer, Faridkot District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Faridkot vide his report No. Elec-2024/5069 dated 12.08.2024 reported that the said notice was served to Sh. Gurcharan Singh Sangha on dated 26.07.2024; and WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Faridkot Supplementary vide letter no -2023-493 dated 25-04- 2023 Sh. Gurcharan Singh Sangha has not submitted any representation of a statement of correct account of election expenses duly signed alongwith original vouchers etc. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Gurcharan Singh Sangha has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account as prescribed under law; and WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- “If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- (a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under this Act, and (b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”; WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Gurcharan Singh Sangha has failed to lodge account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act,1951, the Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Gurcharan Singh Sangha Vill. Sadhanwala Tehsil, & Distt. Faridkot and a contesting candidate in 87-Faridkot Assembly Constituency of the State of Punjab in the General Election to the Legislative Assembly 2022 to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order. and WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent under Section 77 of the said act; Elec.2022/R-11095 dated 09.08.2022 forwarded the District Election Officer, Sangrur has reported that the said notice was served to Shri Jaswinder Singh, dated 11.7.2022; and WHEREAS, the CEO, Punjab vide letter no ELEC-2023/R-5191, dated 21.09.2023 forwarded the District Election Officer, Sangrur Supplementary Report No. 2023/1555 dated 21.09.2023 and reported that Shri Jaswinder Singh has not submitted account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Shri Jaswinder Singh, has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account as prescribed under law; and WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that: - “If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- (a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under this Act, and (b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”; WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Shri Jaswinder Singh, has failed to lodge account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the Election Commission of India hereby declares Shri Jaswinder Singh, Kakarwal Tehsil Dhuri, Distt.Sangrur and a contesting candidate in 107-Dhuri Assembly Constituency of General Election to the Legislative Assembly of -- 7 of 19 -- 8 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : FEBRUARY 1, 2025/MAGHA 12, 1946 [PART II—SEC. 3(iii)] Punjab, 2022, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order. and WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and WHEREAS, the result of the election for 49-Hawamahal Assembly Constituency of Rajasthan, 2023 was declared by the Returning Officer on 3rd December, 2023 and hence the last date for lodging the account of Election Expenses was 02nd January, 2024; and WHEREAS, as per the DEO report dated 04.01.2024 forwarded by the CEO, Rajasthan vide its letter no. F.3(1)(5)EEM/ELECTION/Candidates’Exp./433, dated 16.01.2024, under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, received, Sh. Jameel Ahmed Khan, a contesting candidate from 49-Hawamahal Assembly Constituency of Rajasthan, 2023 has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as required under law; and WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Jaipur a Show-Cause notice No. 76/RJ-LA/2023/CEMS-I, dated 19th March, 2024 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh.Jameel Ahmed Khan, for not lodging of account of Election Expenses; and WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh.Jameel Ahmed Khan, was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District Election Officer, Jaipur District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Jaipur District, vide his letter no. F.3(1) (5)EEM/ ELECTION/ Candidates’Exp./4581, dated 16.04.2024 has reported that the said notice was served to Sh.Jameel Ahmed Khan, on 03.04.2024; and WHEREAS, the CEO, Rajasthan vide letter no F.3(1)(5)EEM/ELECTION/Candidates’Exp./8511, dated 21.08.2024 forwarded the District Election Officer, Jaipur Supplementary Report No 2023 242 dated 13.08.2024 and reported that Sh.Jameel Ahmed Khan has not submitted account of election expenses. Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh.Jameel Ahmed Khan, has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account as prescribed under law; and WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- “If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- (a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under this Act, and (b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.” WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Jameel Ahmed Khan, has failed to lodge account of election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Jameel Ahmed Khan, 58-Kidwai Nagar, Imli Phatak, Jaipur, Rajasthan and a contesting candidate in 49-Hawamahal Assembly Constituency of General Election to the Legislative Assembly of Rajasthan, 2023, to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this order.
